rows.name: Forecast-Distance Fader
rows.rule: Buy NO on NYC daily-high brackets at least 4F away from the NWS forecast high when the NO ask is <= 92c; hold to settlement.

source.label: SFWeather (NWS pipeline) -> NWS gridpoint forecast -> KXHIGHNY

rows.why: Sells far-from-forecast tails. Small steady gains unless the forecast busts by 4F+.

rows.name: NWS Forecast Bracket
rows.rule: Buy YES on the NYC daily-high bracket that contains the point-in-time NWS forecast high when its ask is <= 70c; hold to settlement (The Weather Company CLINYC value).

source.label: SFWeather (NWS pipeline) -> NWS gridpoint forecast for Central Park (OKX/34,45) -> KXHIGHNY

rows.why: Tests whether the official NWS forecast beats the market's bracket pricing. The forecast is archived at decision time so the signal is auditable.

rows.name: Certainty Carry
rows.rule: Buy a 97-99c side on a market with volume that closes within 21 days; hold to settlement.

source.label: Prediction-market carry (buying near-certain outcomes)

rows.why: Earns the last cents on near-certain outcomes with a hard horizon; loses everything if the favourite collapses.

rows.name: CEO-Change Favourite
rows.rule: On Kalshi CEO markets (Companies series tagged CEOs whose ticker names a CEO market), buy the favourite side when its ask is 80-96c and hold to settlement.

source.label: No CEO project exists in MasterSite (verified); Kalshi's CEO-change series (tag CEOs) are traded instead

rows.why: Executive departures are rare, dated events; the favourite (usually NO) tends to carry. Loses the full stake on a surprise exit.

rows.name: Book Edge Sweep
rows.rule: Buy the cheaper executable side when its ask is <= 45c and the displayed spread is >= 2c; sell at a bid >= 1.5x entry, else hold to settlement.

source.label: Kalshi order-book reciprocal rule

rows.why: Price-dislocation hypothesis using only the live book. Pays the spread on entry; wins only if the cheap side re-rates or settles in the money.

rows.name: Favourite-Longshot Fader
rows.rule: When one side is a 5-20c longshot on a market with volume >= 5,000, buy the opposite 80-95c side and hold to settlement.

source.label: Favorite-longshot bias evidence (CEPR / Polymarket paper) - longshots at 5-20c underperform

rows.why: The documented bias: longshots are over-bought. Loses the full stake on the occasional upset.

rows.name: Favorite Holder
rows.rule: Buy a 90-97c favourite on a market with >= 100,000 contracts of volume and hold to settlement.

source.label: CEPR favourite-longshot analysis of 300k+ Kalshi contracts

rows.why: Favourite-longshot bias: heavy favourites on liquid event markets have historically been slightly under-priced.

rows.name: Release Spike Surfer
rows.rule: When the 24h move (last trade vs the last trade a day ago) is >= 20c and 24h volume >= 1,000 on a market >= 24h old, buy the direction of the move with a +2c limit; sell at the first bid above entry, else hold to settlement.

source.label: Season 2026 backtest persona

rows.why: Chases information releases on the official tape. Wins when the print is real (NFL final drive); loses when the spike is a trap.

rows.name: 24h Momentum
rows.rule: When the last trade is >= 3c away from the last trade a day ago (official previous_price field; market must be >= 24h old), buy that direction at the ask with a +2c limit; sell at a bid 5c above entry, else hold to settlement.

source.label: Kalshi market last/previous price fields

rows.why: 24-hour momentum on the official tape. Fails when the last trade is stale or the move was a one-off print.

rows.name: Pine SMA Cross Replay
rows.rule: On verified daily candlesticks: buy YES when SMA5 > SMA10 and last > SMA10 (24h volume > 0); exit at the bid when last < SMA10, else hold to settlement.

source.label: PinePilot - TradingView Pine Script Strategy Lab

rows.why: A Pine-style trend rule replayed on official candles with real fees. The committed backtest showed it pays the spread on 1-tick range crosses.

rows.name: Panic Fade (volatility reversion)
rows.rule: On a 15-minute market's official 1-minute candles, when the latest close is >= 15c below (above) the prior five minutes' high (low), buy the dumped side at the ask with a +2c limit and >= 2 minutes left; sell at a bid 5c above entry, else hold to settlement.

source.label: r/PredictionsMarkets 5,000-strategy KXBTC15M run: volatility reversion was the only profitable archetype (discovery only)

rows.why: Fades over-reactions inside micro markets. The community backtest is unverified; this forward test measures it on official prices.

rows.name: Depth Imbalance
rows.rule: When displayed YES vs NO depth imbalance exceeds 35% (both sides present), buy the heavier side and hold to settlement.

source.label: Kalshi order-book depth

rows.why: Tests whether visible resting depth predicts the outcome. Displayed liquidity can vanish, so the book is logged with every fill.

rows.name: FDA Decision Premium
rows.rule: On Kalshi FDA drug-decision markets (KXFDA* series tagged Medicine), buy the favourite side when its ask is 85-97c and hold to settlement.

source.label: DrugAnalysis - FDA Decisions & Biotech Reactions -> Kalshi KXFDA* series

rows.why: PDUFA outcomes are heavily favoured one way; the premium is the residual. An openFDA point-in-time adapter is the next step.

rows.name: Cheap Dip Hunter
rows.rule: Buy any side quoted between 1c and 5c on a market with traded volume; sell at a bid >= 2x entry, else hold to settlement.

source.label: Season 2026 backtest persona

rows.why: Lottery tickets. The backtest showed one-sided books keep the bid at zero, so most tickets ride to a zero settlement.

rows.name: Expiry Tail Sprint
rows.rule: Inside 48h of close, buy any side quoted at or below 15c and hold to official settlement.

source.label: Kalshi close_time semantics

rows.why: Pure return-seeking tail exposure: many small losses, occasional 6-100x payoffs. Judged only against official results.
